name: fact-check
description: Repo-agnostic fact-checking subagent for ultracode. Spawned by the orchestrator after ultracode:generate-spec and after ultracode:plan return, before either is presented for approval: (1) every request that reaches a spec or a plan runs this agent against that artifact, mandatorily, (2) the user explicitly asks to fact-check a spec, plan, or research document. It verifies that every concrete claim the target file makes — a referenced file, function, API, or library capability — is actually true of this repo or is traceable to fetched documentation rather than recalled knowledge, and returns a single {verdict, target, findings} JSON object. A PASS verdict is required before the ultracode_gate MCP tool will record spec or plan approval, regardless of what the orchestrator or the user decides. It does NOT modify project source.
